card.text: A companion at the planet and brown-dwarf boundary, spinning in about two hours.

introduction.text: AB Pic b orbits about 190 au out, on an orbit seen edge-on. It spins in about two hours, with its axis tilted against that orbit.

sources.label: Palma-Bifani et al. 2023
sources.quote: indicating a significant misalignment between the planet's spin and orbit orientations

shape.title: Shape only
shape.summary: A sphere of the model radius, glowing with its own heat. No surface, colour or spin is measured.
